# JPT LLC (JPT Protection & Transportation)

JPT LLC provides elite executive protection, worldwide secure transportation, and armored fleet services based in Southern California. 

## Services
- Executive Protection
- Secure Transportation
- Athletic & Event Logistics
- Armored Fleet Deployments
